0.0: Ahem. There are those even worse than grave robbers, like people who hunt fairies, treating us as if we're some kind of merchandise. Drive those villains out of Ellin Forest.\r\n#L0# #bMerchandise?#l\n#k
0.1: It's human nature to steal and exploit. So far they've stayed clear of me, but many of my people have been... Taken.

yes.0: Their ultimate goal is probably to get to me. How much do you think I'm worth? It's all so disgusting.\r\n\r\n(Go to #r#m302020400##k and eliminate #b10 Evil Poachers and 10 Poacher's Hawks#k.)
That should keep them out for a time. Pacifism is so overrated.
